figures.name: RBA cash rate target
figures.notes: Monetary policy decision of 29 Sep 2026, effective 30 Sep 2026. Fourth increase of 2026 and the highest level since Nov 2011.

figures.name: Average variable rate, new owner-occupier loans
figures.source: RBA Statistical Table F6 (Housing Lending Rates), published 8 Oct 2026
figures.notes: Series FLRHOFVA: new loans funded in the month, owner-occupied, variable rate, all institutions. This month is before the 29 Sep 2026 cash rate increase, so rates on new loans today are likely higher.

figures.name: APRA serviceability buffer
figures.notes: Lenders must test that new borrowers could still repay at their loan rate plus at least this buffer. Unchanged since 2021.

figures.name: Average weekly ordinary time earnings, full-time adults
figures.source: ABS Average Weekly Earnings, released 13 Aug 2026
figures.notes: About $108,350 a year. Excludes overtime and covers full-time adult employees only.

figures.name: Consumer Price Index, annual inflation
figures.source: ABS Consumer Price Index, released 30 Sep 2026
figures.notes: Monthly CPI, 12 months to Aug 2026. Trimmed mean inflation was 3.6%. Next release 28 Oct 2026 (Sep 2026 data).
